assessment: The KADGIS portal advertises parcel boundaries, but its cadastral dataset catalog describes registered-user request/licensing and ownership attributes; no safe anonymous geometry-only schema was verified.
registryAssessment: Kaduna State Government identifies KADGIS as the state land-administration and digital registry authority; its official 2017 land-use regulation includes Zaria Metro land-administration areas. The current KADGIS site advertises interactive parcel boundaries, while its data catalog says parcel downloads with ownership attributes are limited to registered users/requested licensed access. No safe anonymous feature schema was verified.
